title: Capture only selected task-sync documents through the existing typed export owner
outcome: Provide one snapshot-scoped keyed document capture that reuses the current per-task exporter without scanning unrelated tasks or changing stored formats.
acceptance: The current complete exporter and a keyed capture share one per-task capture implementation, preserving origin, activity, notes, completion, blocker and normalization behavior.

For explicitly selected task IDs, keyed capture reads and decodes only selected task data and reports absence or exchange retirement explicitly; it does not construct or globally validate a partial TaskTree or scan all project IDs.

A 2,000-task fixture compares keyed documents with the same snapshot's complete export for five edits, one addition and one removal, counts selected task loads/decodes, and proves unrelated malformed task payloads are not read.
No SQLite schema, durable record, baseline fingerprint meaning or projection derivation changes; focused checks and the independent review pair pass, with final FULL owned by Merger.

completion.summary: Land selected task document capture in combined task-sync candidate
